FX-GLINT-001.says: The four new settings written at their start values (one colour, #80c0ff, shimmer 0, period 24) on Cross Glare's FX-GLARE-005 (angle 45, white): FX-GLARE-005's numbers, so a glare drawn before Glint Streaks draws the same.

FX-GLINT-002.says: Alternate, orange #ff8000 and blue #0080ff, a plus (angle 0): rays 0 and 2, up and down, are orange; rays 1 and 3, right and left, are blue. The pixel right of the yellow point takes 0.8 squared over 1.2 of its light in blue.

FX-GLINT-003.says: Gradient from red #ff0000 to blue #0000ff: up is red, right two thirds red and one third blue, down one third red and two thirds blue, left blue, mixed in linear light.

FX-GLINT-004.says: Alternate with one ray: the ray is ray 0, so it is orange; Cross Glare with points 1, orange.

FX-GLINT-005.says: Gradient with one ray: the ray is the first colour; FX-GLINT-004 exactly.

FX-GLINT-006.says: Alternate on eight rays from angle 0: up, right, down and left orange, the four diagonals blue.

FX-GLINT-007.says: Alternate with the second colour the same as the first: one colour, Cross Glare's own glare.

FX-GLINT-008.says: FX-GLINT-002 with the second colour written in capitals, #0080FF: the same.

FX-GLINT-009.says: Shimmer 100, period 8, one colour: on frame 0 ray 0 (up) is at full and the others are dimmed by their own phases; on frame 4, half a period on, ray 0 is gone; frame 8, a whole period on, is frame 0 again.

FX-GLINT-010.says: Shimmer 50, period 8, alternate: each ray breathes between half and full strength in its own colour, never gone.

FX-GLINT-011.says: Shimmer keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, period 8: frame 0 is the plain glare, frame 4 is FX-GLINT-009's frame 4.

FX-GLINT-012.says: Shimmer 100, period 16: frame 4 is a quarter period on, as frame 2 is at period 8, so it is FX-GLINT-009's frame 2.

FX-GLINT-013.says: Shimmer 100, period 1: every whole frame is a whole period on, so the rays hold still, each dimmed by its own phase.

FX-GLINT-014.says: FX-GLINT-002 moved three pixels right: the layer grew by 4, and the yellow's blue left ray shows in the two grown columns left of the drawing.

FX-GLINT-015.says: Shimmer 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLINT-016.says: Shimmer period 0.5, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLINT-017.says: Shimmer period 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLINT-018.says: Ray colours "rainbow", not one of "one", "alternate" or "gradient". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLINT-019.says: A second colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GLINT-020.says: Shimmer keyed to 120 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
